module: Groups vehicle configurations into "clusters" (one tile per model or per brand + sub-model) for the vehicle selector grid, and builds each cluster's tile: name, preview, navigation path, favorites and recents, statistics of the representative config, source icons. It is called by ui_vehicleSelector_tiles; a modder rarely uses it directly.
notes: Two cluster modes: 'brandSubModelOrModel' (key = "Brand SubModel", the sub-model defaulting to the model key) and 'model' (key = model_key, followed by the vehicleSelectorSubCluster if useSubCluster is true).

A cluster's preview is /vehicles/<model>/default.png if it exists, otherwise model.preview, otherwise default.jpg. The representative config is the model's default_pc (Automatic or Name sort); otherwise the last of the list sorted according to sortMode.
getClusteredItemsStats sorts clusteredItems.list in place when sortMode is neither 'Automatic' nor 'Name'.
clusterItems: an unknown cluster mode causes an error (clusterModeFunctions[clusterMode] is called without checking).
Cluster tiles carry doubleClickMode = 'capture' and a gotoPath field {'configsForBrandSubModelOrModel', model, sub-model, brand} followed by group.gotoParams.

clusterItems.desc: Groups configs according to the cluster mode. Each cluster contains configsByKey, count, list, as well as years and value (minimums of the configs, for sorting).

configs.desc: Configs to group (each with key and model_key).

createTileFromClusteredItems.desc: Creates a cluster's tile according to the requested mode.

returns.desc: Tile (key, name, preview, subElementCount, favouriteIdx, recentIdx, gotoPath, doubleClickDetails, sourceIcons, Value, Weight, Top Speed, Power, Power/Weight, 0-60 mph, 0-100 km/h, isAuxiliary...), or nil if the mode is unknown.

getClusterModeFunction.desc: Returns the function that computes a config's cluster name for a given mode.

getClusteredItemsFavouriteIconPercent.desc: Walks a cluster to determine the favorites and recents it contains.

returns.desc: Share of favorite configs, between 0 and 1.
Favorite config with the highest index.

getClusteredItemsStats.desc: Chooses a cluster's preview, model, config and representative config according to sortMode.

getSources.desc: Returns the provenance labels and icons of a config: official BeamNG ('beamNG'), custom ('wrench'), Automation (SVG logo), mod ('puzzleModule'), missing jbeam files ('danger').

onlyIcons.desc: true to return only the icons, without the translated text.

returns.desc: List of icons (and texts if onlyIcons is false).
